title: Japanese Kabanos Yakitori
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Japanese-inspired dish featuring grilled kabanos sausage served on skewers with a sweet soy sauce glaze.
instructions: 2. Thread kabanos onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
3. In a small saucepan, whisk together mirin, soy sauce, and brown sugar. Bring to a boil over medium heat.
4. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
5. Brush the glaze onto both sides of the sausage.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the kabanos is caramelized and cooked through.
7. Garnish with chopped green onions and sesame seeds, if desired.
